verdict.rationale: NVIDIA docs cite architecture and performance claims but never publish explicit sustained-workload power envelopes or perf-per-watt figures for ML workloads; independent testing (comm-6, comm-9) directly contradicts any efficiency narrative, finding perf-per-watt similar to or worse than the RTX 4080/4090 despite higher raw throughput, and power-connector reliability issues (comm-2, comm-11) further undercut sustained power-efficiency claims. missing for 10: documented sustained power envelope specs for ML workloads, first-party perf/watt benchmarks, independent corroboration of efficiency claims (only contradicting evidence exists).
